metadata.purpose: Automated preliminary calculation and governance logic for pressure-vessel hydrostatic and pneumatic test pressure.

allowable_stress_source.required_document: ASME BPVC Section II Part D, Subpart 1
allowable_stress_source.required_edition_rule: Use the project-controlled edition compatible with the Section VIII Division 1 design basis.
allowable_stress_source.manual_value_requirement: Each allowable stress value shall carry material record ID, specification, grade, class or condition, product form, thickness range, temperature, table, note IDs, code edition and verification status.

code_basis.source_control_rule: Do not silently combine unmatched code editions for production calculations.

allow_design_pressure_as_mawp_assumption.code_basis: Footnote 35 permits MAWP to be assumed equal to design pressure when MAWP calculations are not made.

lowest_stress_ratio.formula: LSR = min(SR_i for applicable pressure-boundary materials)

calculated_test_pressure_basis.definition: Highest permissible internal pressure for each vessel element, calculated from the applicable design equation using nominal thickness with corrosion allowance included and allowable stress at the test temperature.

priority: When MAWP calculations are not made, design pressure may be assumed equal to MAWP only when the project enables the Footnote 35 assumption.

lsr_algorithm.step_1_nonbolting_ratios: Calculate S_test / S_design for every nonbolting pressure-boundary material.
lsr_algorithm.step_4_final_lsr: If any bolting trigger is true, include that bolt's ratio S_bolt_test / S_bolt_design in the candidate ratios and recalculate LSR. Otherwise exclude bolting.
fail_closed_rules: Block if a required pressure-boundary material is missing.
Block if S_design or S_test is zero, negative or unresolved.
Block if a triggered bolt lacks specified minimum yield strength at test temperature.
Block if stress units are inconsistent.
Block production status if stress code edition is not the controlled edition.

UG_99_b_standard_hydrostatic.applicability: Standard hydrostatic test for vessels designed for internal pressure.
UG_99_b_standard_hydrostatic.pressure_basis: P_basis = calculated MAWP; if MAWP is not calculated and project approval is enabled, P_basis = design pressure under Footnote 35.
UG_99_b_standard_hydrostatic.gauge_setpoint_raw: P_gauge_raw = max over all points [1.3 * P_basis * LSR + rho * g * (z_point - z_gauge) / 1000000]
UG_99_b_standard_hydrostatic.point_pressure_check: P_actual_point = P_gauge_setpoint + rho * g * (z_gauge - z_point) / 1000000; require P_actual_point >= 1.3 * P_basis * LSR

calculated_pressure_advisory.rule: ASME does not specify an upper hydrostatic test-pressure limit under UG-99(d). Flag engineering review when actual pressure exceeds the calculated-pressure value because visible permanent distortion can lead to rejection.

mandatory_checks: All fabrication and required pretest examinations completed.
All test loadings and test support conditions considered.
Test liquid below its boiling point.
Test equipment and temporary closures verified.
MDMT and brittle-fracture test-temperature requirements verified.

UG_99_c_calculated_hydrostatic.applicability: Calculated-pressure hydrostatic test by agreement between user and Manufacturer.
UG_99_c_calculated_hydrostatic.test_pressure_at_top: P_test_top = min(P_top_candidate_i for all pressure elements)
UG_99_c_calculated_hydrostatic.verification_at_each_element: P_actual_i = P_test_top + rho * g * (z_top - z_element_i) / 1000000; require P_actual_i <= 1.3 * P_calculated_test_basis_i
mandatory_checks: Agreement between user and Manufacturer recorded.
Calculated test-pressure basis available for every pressure element.
Nominal thickness includes corrosion allowance for calculated test basis.
Allowable stress at test temperature used.

UG_100_b_pneumatic.applicability: Pneumatic test in lieu of hydrostatic test when the vessel cannot safely be filled with water or cannot tolerate residual test liquid.
UG_100_b_pneumatic.pressure_basis: P_basis = calculated MAWP; if MAWP is not calculated and project approval is enabled, P_basis = design pressure under Footnote 35.
UG_100_b_pneumatic.gauge_setpoint_raw: P_gauge_raw = max over all points [1.1 * P_basis * LSR + rho_gas * g * (z_point - z_gauge) / 1000000]
UG_100_b_pneumatic.feasibility_rule: If the rounded gauge setpoint causes any point pressure to exceed 1.1 times that point's calculated test-pressure basis, block the pneumatic test calculation.

pressure_application_sequence.initial_stage_max: Increase gradually to not more than 0.5 * P_test.
pressure_application_sequence.subsequent_steps: Increase in steps of approximately 0.1 * P_test until P_test is reached.
pressure_application_sequence.inspection_pressure: Reduce to P_test / 1.1 and hold for inspection.

mandatory_checks: Pneumatic-test risk assessment and exclusion zone approved.
Calculated test-pressure basis available for every pressure element.
MDMT and brittle-fracture test-temperature requirements verified.

UG_99_f_vacuum_only_internal_pressure_te.applicability: Single-wall vessel or individual chamber designed for vacuum only, with MAWP less than or equal to zero.
UG_99_f_vacuum_only_internal_pressure_te.alternative_route: Vacuum test at the lowest specified absolute internal design pressure plus a qualified leak test procedure.
UG_99_f_vacuum_only_internal_pressure_te.automation_status: Internal-pressure option automated; alternative vacuum leak-test route requires manual procedure review.

rounding_and_acceptance_logic.hydrostatic_rule: After rounding, re-evaluate pressure at every point and issue calculated-pressure advisory warnings.
rounding_and_acceptance_logic.pneumatic_rule: After rounding, re-evaluate pressure at every point. Do not permit rounding to violate the 1.1 times calculated-test-pressure-basis upper limit.

validation_rules.message: This library is controlled for ASME Section VIII Division 1, 2023.
Combination-unit and common-element differential-pressure logic is outside automated scope.

validation_rules.condition: mawp_mpa_g is null AND NOT allow_design_pressure_as_mawp_assumption
validation_rules.message: Provide calculated MAWP or explicitly approve the Footnote 35 design-pressure assumption.
Allowable-stress edition mismatch. Automatic production use is blocked.
Pneumatic upper-limit verification cannot be completed.
Pneumatic test risk controls are not approved.
Hydrotest operating weight and support condition shall be verified.
Route to the applicable material or construction-specific Code rule.

calculation_sequence: Validate code edition, vessel configuration, method and special-construction routing.
Select pressure basis using calculated MAWP or the explicitly approved Footnote 35 design-pressure assumption.
Resolve and verify allowable stresses at design and test temperatures.
Calculate material stress ratios and preliminary LSR excluding bolting.
Apply the method-specific bolting inclusion trigger and calculate final LSR.
Calculate raw test pressure using the selected UG-99 or UG-100 module.
Apply static-head correction using gauge and evaluation-point elevations.
Round upward only after the raw pressure has been determined.
Recalculate actual pressure at every evaluation point.
Apply method-specific lower-bound, upper-limit and advisory checks.
Generate inspection pressure, pressure-step instructions, warnings and audit trace.
Return preliminary status and require engineering approval before issue for fabrication or testing.

select_pressure_basis: if mawp_calculated and mawp_mpa_g is not null: P_basis = mawp_mpa_g
else if allow_design_pressure_as_mawp_assumption and design_pressure_mpa_g is not null: P_basis = design_pressure_mpa_g; assumption_used = true
calculate_lsr: nonbolt_ratios = [S_test / S_design for each nonbolt pressure-boundary material]
factor = 1.3 for hydrostatic else 1.1 for pneumatic
for each bolt: include when factor * LSR_preliminary * S_bolt_design > 0.90 * Sy_bolt_test
LSR = min(nonbolt_ratios plus included bolt ratios)
standard_test: P_gauge_raw = max(P_required + rho * g * (z_point - z_gauge) / 1000000 for each point)

governance_notes: The test-pressure calculation is only one part of test readiness.
The app shall not approve pneumatic testing solely from a numerical pressure result.
The app shall retain all material stress records and the governing LSR for audit.
The app shall distinguish calculated MAWP from a Footnote 35 design-pressure assumption.
The app shall fail closed where the pneumatic calculated-pressure upper limit cannot be verified.

Final test pressure, test temperature, test position, test medium, supports, temporary closures, gaskets, bolting, inspection and safety controls require responsible engineer, Manufacturer and Inspector review as applicable.
